title: Be authorised to keep gaming machines
what: Keep or dispose of an approved gaming machine in a hotel or club only as authorised by the Independent Liquor and Gaming Authority.

sources.title: Gaming Machines Act 2001 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A hotelier or club must not keep or dispose of an approved gaming machine unless— (a) the keeping or disposal of the gaming machine is authorised by the Authority,
